Questions 1–10

Complete the notes below.

Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

JOB ENQUIRY

JOB ENQUIRY
  • Example
  • Work at ：
  • a restaurant
  • Type of work:
  • Number of hours per week: 12 hours
  • Would need work permit
  • Work in the branch
  • Nearest bus stop: next to
  • Pay: ￡ an hour
  • Extra Benefits: - a free dinner - extra pay when you work on - transport home when you work
  • Qualities required: - - ability to
  • Interview arranged for: Thursday at 6 p.m.
  • Bring the name of two referees
  • Ask for: Samira

transcript.zh: 晚上好，这里是国王饭店。

transcript.en: I'm ringing about the job I understand you have vacant?
transcript.zh: 我打电话是想询问你们那里的一个工作空缺

transcript.en: I'd like to find out a few more details if I may.

transcript.zh: 我能问一下你的名字吗

transcript.en: Well, if you want to ask about the job and then if we're both still interested, we could arrange for you to come for an interview.
transcript.zh: 彼得，如果你想了解这份工作，并且之后我们双方仍感兴趣的话，我们可以安排你来面试，

transcript.en: I'm afraid I missed the advert for the job but heard about it from a friend.
transcript.zh: 恐怕我错过了招聘广告，但是我从一个朋友那里听说了

transcript.en: What would you like to know?
Well, um, what sort of work is it - washing up?
transcript.zh: 那是什么样的工作，洗碗吗？

transcript.en: And how many nights a week would it be?
transcript.zh: 很好。一周要工作几个晚上？

transcript.en: Well, we're really only busy at the weekend.
Three actually, so it would work out at 12 hours a week.
transcript.zh: 事实上是三个，所以一周要工作12个小时。

transcript.en: It wouldn't interfere with my studies.
transcript.zh: 这样就不会干扰我的学习了
是的，物理系一年级学生

transcript.en: Um, and because I'm not an EU national, would I need a work permit?
transcript.zh: 因为我不属于欧盟国家，所以我需要一张工作许可吗？

transcript.en: Just get you tutor to sign it.
That wouldn't be a problem if I were to get the job.
transcript.zh: 如果我能得到那份工作就没有问题

transcript.en: Um, where exactly is the restaurant?
Well, we have two branches - the one we're recruiting for is in Hillsdunne road.
transcript.zh: 我们有两家分支，我们招募的那家在Hillsdunne路。

transcript.en: How do you spell it, please?
Is it near a bus stop?
transcript.zh: 谢谢，附近有公交车站吗，

transcript.en: Yes, the nearest one would probably be just beside the library.
transcript.zh: 有。最近的一个可能就在图书馆旁边。

transcript.en: And could I ask about the pay?
My last job was £3.95 an hour.
transcript.zh: 我上一份工作是每小时3.95英镑

transcript.en: We feel it's pretty good and we also offer some good fringe benefits.
transcript.zh: 我们觉得这很不错，而且我们还提供一些附加福利，

transcript.en: Well, we give you a free dinner, so you eat well.
transcript.zh: 我们为你提供免费的晚餐，所以你会吃的很好。

transcript.en: And we also offer extra pay for working on national holidays.
transcript.zh: 另外在国家法定假日工作，我们还会多付薪水，

transcript.en: Oh, that's a really good perk, isn't it?
transcript.zh: 这是一笔很好的额外收入，不是吗？

transcript.en: And then because of the difficulties of getting public transport, if you're working after 11 o'clock, we drive you home.
transcript.zh: 我们是这么想的，如果你工作到11点以后，由于难以搭上公共交通，我们会开车送你回家，

transcript.en: Well, we'd certainly be interested in inviting you for an interview, if you're still interested?
transcript.zh: 我们希望邀请你来面试，如果你还感兴趣的话？

transcript.en: Could I just also ask what qualities you're looking for?
transcript.zh: 我能问一下你们有什么要求吗

transcript.en: Well, for this particular job, we want a clear voice, which you obviously do have.
transcript.zh: 这份工作需要有一副清楚的嗓音，你肯定合格！

transcript.en: And you must be able to think quickly, you know.
So, when could you come in for an interview?
transcript.zh: 那么你什么时候可以来面试
其实我们今晚这里比较安静

transcript.en: Sorry, I couldn't come tonight or tomorrow, I'm afraid.
transcript.zh: 对不起，我恐怕今晚或者明天都不能去

transcript.en: Thursday is ok, that'd be 22nd of October.
And could you bring along the names of two referees?
transcript.zh: 你能告诉我两名推荐人的名字吗

transcript.en: Good, I look forward to seeing you.
Oh, by the way, who should I ask for?
transcript.zh: 顺便说一下，我应该找谁呢？
